summary: The rhaap:create-project Backstage action creates an AAP project linked to an SCM repo. Inputs: token (required), deleteIfExist, and values with projectName, organization {id}, scmUrl (required), plus optional projectDescription, credentials, scmBranch and scmUpdateOnLaunch. It outputs project details including project.id.
questions: How do I create an AAP project from a Backstage template?
What does deleteIfExist do in rhaap actions?
